Rules: NON-PRODUCTION ONLY. ALWAYS pass `-c example_nonprod` explicitly (the default connection is example_prod!). If the prompt targets prod, stop and tell the orchestrator to use sub-expert-snow-prod.

Default to SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE with LIMIT. DML/DDL (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, CREATE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE, GRANT) only with an AUTHORIZED WRITE block showing the exact statement; wrap in a transaction where possible and report affected rows.

Authentication uses an external-browser SSO login: a snow call may open a browser and wait. Do NOT run `snow connection list/test`; it triggers a login. If a call hangs or asks for login, stop and tell the orchestrator.
Use `--format json` and cap rows; do not print PII columns in full.

CliTools.Name: snow
CliTools.UseCase: Snowflake CLI. Example: `snow -c example_nonprod sql -q "select current_role(), current_warehouse()"`. Connection: example_nonprod (EXAMPLE-NONPROD, role PUBLIC).
